## Change summary / 変更概要

Describe what changed and why. Link a relevant issue if available.

## Evidence and scope / 検証範囲

- [ ] I stated whether each result is **verified**, **reported**, **hypothesis**, or **not tested**.
- [ ] I supplied reproducible commands, relevant commits and logs for any claimed PASS.
- [ ] I did not equate DTS syntax checks with kernel build, device boot, networking or recovery validation.

## Publication and rights / 公開・権利確認

- [ ] I reviewed **every added or modified file** for credentials, device-unique identifiers, embedded OEM materials and unredacted logs.
- [ ] Imported code or data has an identified source, author, license and redistribution basis.
- [ ] No private signing keys, factory dumps, calibration data, certificates, IMEI, MAC addresses or serial numbers are included.
- [ ] This PR does not introduce unverified flashing instructions or distribute a signed boot image.

## CI / テスト結果

Provide workflow run URLs, commit SHAs, result status and any known failures. Do not mark checks PASS before reviewing completed runs.

## Remaining risks / 未解決事項

Describe outstanding test failures, source-provenance gaps and hardware safety limitations. If a checklist item is unmet, explain why the PR is draft or blocked.
